candidate.description: max(ensemble risk, support-aware repeated-shortfall risk). The shortfall risk uses the Wilson lower bound of an agent's cash-shortfall report rate against the train-population median rate, and needs shortfall reports from at least 2 distinct customers.
candidate.name: ensemble_v2_shortfall

final_cohort_rule: generated and scored once, only after dev_results.json exists and its hash is recorded; never used for any choice
interval_method: 95% Wilson score interval on pooled independent-agent counts; per-replication values shown for seed variation
prevalence: agent_mix and customers-per-agent proportions copied from the canonical config; documented 'moderate' skimming profile

scenario_definitions.moderate: Documented default: fee overcharge plus payout reduction, moderate intensity
scenario_definitions.obvious: Obvious intensity: frequent large overcharges and payout reductions
scenario_definitions.sparse_reports: Moderate intensity, only 20% of customers report cash received
scenario_definitions.subtle: Subtle intensity: rare small overcharges and rare 1-3% payout reductions
scenario_definitions.unchanged_fee_shortfall_moderate: Ledger fee is exactly correct; only the cash paid out is short (moderate payout reduction)
scenario_definitions.unchanged_fee_shortfall_subtle: Ledger fee is exactly correct; only rare small cash shortfalls (subtle payout reduction)

selection_rule.evaluated_on: validation cohorts, pooled over replications; never on final cohorts
